Name: Yagisan's Custom NPCs for NPC Map Locations
Author: Yagichan
Description:
This mod was created to show custom NPC's on the world map using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/239]NPC Map Locations[/url]. [b]It does not include any maps.[/b]

[size=5][b]Install[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/239]NPC Map Locations[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font]
[*]Install any custom NPCs you want to use, following the instruction on their mod pages.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[b]These mods are optional, and they will be skipped if they are missing.[/b]

Locations and tooltips are dynamically enabled for each support mod. For example, if you don't use East Scarp, you won't get those locations and tooltip on your map.

If a mod supports an NPC with a selectable gender, only the default gender will be supported, if they share the same unique ID.

This mod supports NPCs and Locations from a variety of mods. I've divided them into several tiers.

[b]Tier 1[/b] mods, are mods that I regularly use myself and I will update them as soon as practical.
[b]Tier 2[/b] mods, are mods that I don't use, but seem supported by their authors. Please let me know if they need an update.
[b]Tier 3[/b] mods, are mods that I don't use, but seem broken and/or abandoned and/or hidden on Nexus. Please let me know if they need an update.

[b][size=5]Known Issues[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]NPCs appear in the top left corner of the map. Not actually a bug with this mod's data. That location is where [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/239]NPC Map Locations[/url] draws things it doesn't know where they go by default. Those NPCs are typically not directly supported yet. Let me know who they are!
[*]Several NPCs use complex conditions to decide when to enable or disable themselves. These conditions successfully trigger, but NPC Map Locations ignores them until the game is restarted. [url=https://github.com/bouhm/stardew-valley-mods/issues/85]Reported upstream here.[/url]
[/list]
